name: wafw00f
description: wafw00f is a Web Application Firewall (WAF) detector that helps to identify and fingerprint WAFs and other security mechanisms.

inputs.label: Target URL:
inputs.help: The URL of the web application to test. You must provide a target URL.

inputs.label: Target List File Path (-i):
inputs.help: File containing a list of target URLs (one per line).

inputs.label: Upload Target List File (-i):
inputs.help: Upload a file containing a list of target URLs (one per line).

inputs.label: Random User-Agent (-r)
inputs.help: Use a random User-Agent from the included list for each request.

inputs.label: Proxy (--proxy):
inputs.help: Use a proxy to connect to the target URL.

inputs.label: Follow Redirects (--follow-redirects)
inputs.help: Follow HTTP redirects.

inputs.label: Skip Redirect Check (--skip-redirect-check)
inputs.help: Skip checking for redirects.

inputs.label: Threads (-t):
inputs.help: Number of concurrent threads (default: 20).

inputs.label: Delay (-D):
inputs.help: Delay between requests in seconds.

inputs.label: Verbose (-v)
inputs.help: Increase verbosity level.

inputs.label: Additional Headers (-H):
inputs.help: Add custom HTTP headers. One header per line.

inputs.label: POST Data (-d):
inputs.help: Send data with POST request.

inputs.label: Text Output File (-o):
inputs.help: Save output to a text file.

inputs.label: XML Output File (-x):
inputs.help: Save output to an XML file.

inputs.label: JSON Output File (-j):
inputs.help: Save output to a JSON file.

inputs.label: Output All Formats (-a)
inputs.help: Output in all available formats (text, XML, and JSON).

inputs.label: Show All WAFs (-S)
inputs.help: Show all WAFs, not just the identified one.

inputs.label: Additional Arguments:
inputs.help: Any other wafw00f arguments not covered by the GUI. Enter them exactly as you would on the command line.

inputs.label: List WAFs (-l)
inputs.help: List all WAFs that wafw00f is able to detect.

inputs.label: Skip All Checks (-k)
inputs.help: Skip all checks for a given URL. Useful if you already know it's a WAF.

inputs.label: No Color (--no-color)
inputs.help: Disable color in the output.
